sections.label: 🔧 Code Quality
items: Dead-code audit: ran ESLint (no-unused-vars/no-unreachable/no-unused-expressions, scoped .eslintrc.json added) plus a manual whole-file cross-reference pass over all 777 top-level function/const/let declarations, all 219 configSchema settings keys, and all injected .mb-*/.sa-* CSS classes. Every candidate below was individually verified against its actual call sites (not just a zero-reference count) before removal.
Removed isSpecialDialogOpen(): fully-implemented helper with no call sites anywhere in the script.

Removed guardColFilterPrefixKeydown: a @deprecated alias of guardFilterPrefixKeydown that was never referenced anywhere else in the script (the canonical guardFilterPrefixKeydown() is used directly at all call sites).

Removed _fnRegistry from openSettingsWithConfigButtons(): built and immediately discarded — the very next statement passed an identical inline object literal to Lib.showSettings() instead, a leftover from an earlier refactor.

Removed setMenuBtnFocus() and its supporting chooseConfigBtnRef/menuBtnFocused scaffolding from the column-visibility menu: an unfinished keyboard-focus-highlight helper that was never wired to any focus/blur listener. The visibility menu's real keyboard-focus highlighting is implemented separately and completely in buildColVisMenuKeyboard()/moveFocusTo(), which already handles this correctly.

Removed showExportNotification() and showDownloadNotification(): a legacy popup-notification pair with zero remaining callers. All CSV/JSON/HTML/org-mode exports now go through showExportDialog() (filename-confirmation dialog) and the Save-to-Disk path through showSaveDialog(); both superseded this pair some time ago but the dead functions and their stale JSDoc cross-references ("Triggers showExportNotification() on success", etc.) were left behind. Corrected the now-inaccurate JSDoc on exportTableToCSV() and several inline comments accordingly.

Removed applyUniqVal(): the single-value column-filter setter, superseded by the checkbox-driven applyUniqValueSet(). Confirmed dead via its own comments ("...instead of the old single-value applyUniqVal()...") and by tracing makeInlineArtItem(), which actually delegates through _wireStructureCheckbox()/applyUniqValueSet(), not applyUniqVal() as its own comment claimed. Reworded the now-inaccurate 'applyUniqVal(...)' illustrative mentions in testRowMatch()'s sentinel-value bypass comments to describe the behavior generically instead of naming a removed function.

Removed the _seriesH2EntityType and resolveSeriesEntityFeatures backward-compatibility aliases (of _getH2EntityType and resolveEntityFeaturesFromH2 respectively): both were explicitly documented as compat shims for external call sites, but had zero internal references. Updated the page-definition comments and one Lib.debug() label that still named the old resolveSeriesEntityFeatures alias to reference resolveEntityFeaturesFromH2 directly.

Removed REL_DISCOGRAPHY_MAPPINGS (declaration and its _loadMap('sa_rel_discography_mappings', ...) population): populated at startup but never read anywhere, unlike its sibling REL_URL_ICON_CLASSES/REL_OTHER_DB_CLASSES/REL_STREAMING_CLASSES, which are all looked up via bracket access in the Relationships column's icon-resolution code. Also removed its now-orphaned sa_rel_discography_mappings settings-schema entry.

Removed the sa_ui_h2_artist_rgs_global_bg settings-schema entry: describes a configurable background color for the Artist RGs global super-header, but the button that sets that header's background hardcodes '#1b5e20' directly instead of reading the setting.

Removed the sa_sort_progress_threshold settings-schema entry: intended to gate a sort-progress indicator, but the sole call site of sortLargeArray() passes progressCallback as null, and sortLargeArray() only invokes that callback when truthy — the progress-indicator mechanism this setting was meant to control is unreachable.
Removed the sa_ui_download_notification_font_size settings-schema entry as a cascading consequence of the showDownloadNotification() removal above — its only reader was that function.

Removed duplicated dead local variables otherListId/otherVisible/otherEl (computed but never read) from both pin-list and LRU-list arrow-key keydown handlers in the filter-history dropdown — leftover scaffolding for a cross-list wrap-around feature that was never implemented.
Removed three orphaned CSS rules with no element ever carrying the class: .mb-show-all-btn-active, .mb-subtable-status-display, .sa-history-item:hover.

Removed five CSS classes assigned via className/classList.add that no stylesheet rule or selector ever matches: mb-cdtoc-inner-tracklist, mb-col-uniq-syn-box, mb-column-visibility-menu, mb-density-menu, mb-filter-wrapper. Each element still functions identically via its existing inline style.cssText/id.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: determineMaxPageFromDOM(): fixed unreachable code — a Lib.debug() call was placed after its enclosing branch's return statement and never executed. Reordered so the debug log fires before the return.
